patch_description: Reorganizes construction into demand preparation, direct-link scoring, and sparse route scoring. Instead of spreading each OD pair’s indirect reward across every possible intermediate, it retains only its three strongest supported two-hop routes, with congestion discounting based on component-edge demand and transit-node pressure. This reduces quadratic-term count, avoids rewarding implausible routes, and keeps the indirect reward budget bounded per OD pair. The returned interface and evaluator-supplied degree penalties are unchanged.
